popCulture.title: Celaeno (Harpy)
popCulture.description: Virgil's dark Harpy — Celaeno prophesies that the Trojans will eat their tables before Italy.

popCulture.title: Aeneid
popCulture.creator: Virgil
popCulture.description: Book III's Strophades episode makes Celaeno the Harpy who speaks destiny, not only snatches the feast.

popCulture.title: Harpy
popCulture.description: The later third sister joins Aello and Ocypete in the Roman afterlife of the storm-snatchers.
